scope: Native Windows host and its WSL2 Linux guest: two kernels, one physical host, existing private virtual network, IPv4 only.
windows_package: Official PyPI v0.9.1 wheel, SHA-256 verified
network_policy: Receivers bound to the explicit host-side WSL virtual interface, on ephemeral ports. No test-created firewall rules, route or interface changes.

sanitization.interfaces: replaced with if-N labels; loopback kept
sanitization.hostnames: host fields that are not addresses replaced with host-N.example
sanitization.timestamps: shifted by one constant offset per batch; the earliest becomes 2000-01-01T00:00:00+00:00
sanitization.retained: payload sizes, outcomes, RTTs, probe and run IDs, ICMP event fields

probe.interpretation: Acknowledgement confirms delivery and a small reply. Timeout is inconclusive. packet_too_large records EMSGSIZE in DF mode; a kernel-reported MTU is current kernel knowledge, not an independently measured path MTU. ICMP error-queue observations are untrusted network feedback, not independent proof of the path or sender identity.

correlation.interpretation: Receiver observation confirms forward arrival. No matching observation is inconclusive unless capture coverage is independently established. A sent acknowledgement does not prove return delivery. Per-attempt timestamps are shown side by side but clocks on different hosts are not compared. With sized replies, receiver_observed_sized_reply_missing means the probe arrived and the receiver had a same-sized reply accepted by its local socket, but the sender recorded none before its deadline. This does not identify where or why the return failed. receiver_reply_send_failed means the receiver's own socket rejected the attempted reply. receiver_reply_send_unverified means the receiver did not record the local send outcome; it does not establish that a reply was sent.

sender.interpretation: One sender with same-sized replies: an acknowledged attempt carried its size in both directions, so the search interval reflects the smaller of the two directions. small_ack_only means the receiver did not send same-sized replies. Runs are sequential and may be affected by route or PMTU-cache changes. Missing ACKs and absent ICMP are inconclusive; observed ICMP is untrusted feedback. A reported interval is not an independently measured end-to-end path MTU.

fragmentation_comparison.interpretation: Two sequential sender-side experiments. The second permits source fragmentation but does not prove fragments traversed the path. Different results suggest a useful follow-up, not a root cause. Timeouts are missing ACKs, not proven packet loss.

limitations: Controlled Windows/WSL2 host/guest path, not independent operator evidence or physical multi-host validation.
Healthy sizes through 1400 bytes; no exact path-MTU boundary or oversized Windows reply was measured.
IPv4 and existing virtual-network policy only; remote Windows firewall profiles and IPv6 cross-host paths need separate evidence.
Related report files were batch-sanitized together; this wrapper adds only reviewed non-private OS/version and scope metadata.
No comparison of clocks across kernels; the probe protocol and receiver logs remain unauthenticated.
